hooks.name: aidlc-shell-post
hooks.description: Merged PostToolUse(execute_bash) hook: runtime graph compile THEN aidlc-state.md Current Stage sync, in one process. Supersedes the separate aidlc-runtime-compile and aidlc-sync-statusline registrations, which shared this matcher and so paid two bun startups per shell command for two payload-independent hooks. DELIBERATELY matched to execute_bash, not a task/spec tool: the IDE surfaces no task payload a sync could parse, so the state sync derives the stage from the audit tail (do not 'optimize' this to a task matcher). Cost: bounded — the sync reads a 64 KB audit tail rather than the whole trail, falling back to a full read only when the window holds no STAGE_STARTED. If an older install still carries aidlc-runtime-compile.json or aidlc-sync-statusline.json, delete them; --doctor reports the overlap.
